decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-32984cccce52] states a single coherent removal: the previously deprecated MetalLB-based BGP flags (`bgp-config-path`, `bgp-announce-lb-ip`, `bgp-announce-pod-cidr`) are removed in 1.17.0. All three flags belong to the same `metallb-bgp` feature, so this is one change rather than several. The excerpt also says the replacement is the Cilium BGP control plane, so the subject (the metallb-bgp flag set), the change (removal, replacedBy the BGP control plane) and applicability (environments that set any of these flags) can be written down. For an operator who does nothing, the excerpt only implies the consequence: MetalLB-based BGP advertisement no longer works. It does not say whether leftover flags cause a startup error or are ignored, which is why confidence is low.
